name: Vagabond
overview:
The story begins in 1600 after the bloody Battle of Sekigahara. Shinmen Takezo, a wild and violent youth, survives the slaughter and leaves his isolated village to prove his worth to the world. Seeking to become "unrivaled under heaven," he discards his past and renames himself Musashi Miyamoto.

As he travels feudal Japan challenging legendary masters, the narrative evolves from a chronicle of brutal duels into a profound philosophical journey. Vagabond explores the psychological weight of violence, the burden of isolation, and the true meaning of strength. Renowned for its breathtaking brushwork and rich character development, the series brilliantly contrasts visceral combat with a quiet, deeply personal quest for enlightenment.
